task: VIBEQUEUE-68: anatomy of KV-cache reuse output differences (diagnostic, CPU-only)
ordering: this prereg freeze precedes any classification; mechanical identification of differing records may precede the freeze and did (count only)

retained_fields: A/C: prediction, natural_generated_ids, fixed_generated_ids, fixed_ids_sha256, quality(em/f1/presence), stop_reason

arms.cached: C = optimized all-hit canonical reuse (CanonicalCache store prebuilt)
arms.fresh: A = original monolithic ddi_qf on SDPA
arms.decoding: greedy, budgets 48/16, dtype bfloat16, checkpoint Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ddi_qf 8L restart

record_selection_rule: every confirmation record where cached prediction != fresh prediction under the frozen dev eval (C.prediction != A.prediction in qa_requests.jsonl); extractor asserts consistency with the retained prediction_equal flag

definitions_verbatim_from_ticket.near_tie_greedy_flip: minimal-edit difference (entity swap, synonym, word-order, punctuation/function-word change) where both outputs answer in the same neighborhood
definitions_verbatim_from_ticket.truncation_stopping_artifact: one output is a prefix/subset or differs mainly in length/stopping

classification_rubric.ambiguous_rule: explicit allowed label; never force a bucket; use when evidence does not discriminate
classification_rubric.decision_guidance: pick the label whose description dominates the observed difference; when near-tie and truncation features co-occur, judge which reading dominates; if genuinely unclear, label ambiguous; near-tie is a structural/textual judgment only (logits unavailable, no probability margin verifiable)

divergence_position_taxonomy.first_token_divergence: index 0 of retained natural_generated_ids differs (same quantity as retained first_token_equal; extractor asserts agreement)
divergence_position_taxonomy.mid_generation_divergence: first differing model-token position > 0, or pure length difference with common prefix
divergence_position_taxonomy.tokenization_assumption: retained ids are Qwen2.5 generation ids counted from 0 = first sampled token after the prompt; natural generations end at <|im_end|> (151645); fallback measure = whitespace tokenization of prediction strings (str.split()), first differing whitespace-token index; model-token measure is primary
divergence_position_taxonomy.role: reported feature, not itself a classification label

interpretation_rules: diagnostic-only language; no fix evaluation, no mechanism attribution
tiny n (22 differing of 100, single seed, single checkpoint); no rate claims; counts/shares are descriptive of this sample only
no causal claims; 'consistent with' language only
logits unavailable: near-tie claims are structural analogies, stated as such
every number traces to a sha-pinned artifact; missing data reported as missing

against: V60 dev-20 residual analysis (3/20 differed; ticket records ~50% first-token / ~50% mid-generation, claimed 'no semantic signature')
verdict_options: agrees on position mix but disagrees on semantic signature
